verses.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਤ੍ਰ੍ਰੈ ਲੋਕ ਵੇਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨ ਲੰਘਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: brahamaa bisan mahes trrai lok vedh gun giaan la(n)ghaae|

en.bdb: The gurmukhs have gone ahead of the three worlds, three gunas (rajas, sattva and tamas) and Brahma Visnu Mahesa.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭੂਤ ਭਵਿਖਹੁ ਵਰਤਮਾਨੁ ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਜਿਣਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਿਧਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: bhoot bhavikhahu varatamaan aadh madh jin a(n)t sidhaae|

en.bdb: They know the mystery of the beginning, the middle, the end, of past, present and future.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕਰਮ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ੍ਰ ਕਰਿ ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣ ਜੀਵਣ ਜਿਣਿ ਆਏ।
verses.translit_en: man bach karam ikatrr kar ja(n)man maran jeevan jin aae|

en.bdb: They keep together in one line their mind, speech and action and conquer birth, life and death.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਧਿ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਸਾਧਿ ਸੁਰਗ ਮਿਰਤ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਨਿਵਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: aadh biaadh upaadh saadh surag mirat paataal nivaae|

en.bdb: Subjugating all the maladies, they have humbled this world, heaven and the nether world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਤਮੁ ਮਧਮ ਨੀਚ ਸਾਧਿ ਬਾਲਕ ਜੋਬਨ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਜਿਣਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: autam madham neech saadh baalak joban biradh jinaae|

en.bdb: Winning the top, middle and the lowest positions they have conquered the childhood, youth and the old age.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇੜਾ ਪਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਸੁਖਮਨਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਲੰਘਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਬੇਣੀ ਨ੍ਹਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: eiRaa pi(n)gulaa sukhamanaa tirakuTee la(n)gh tirabenee nhaae|

en.bdb: Crossing trikuti, the conjunction of three naris – ira, pingala, susumna in between the  eyebrows, they have bathed in the triveni, the pilgrimage centre at the  confluence of Ganges, Yamuna and Sarasvati.
With concentrated mind, gurmukhs adore only one Lord.
